template.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: single neutral white 3D vinyl wrap master, transparent PNG for game cosmetic thumbnails. Image1 is the existing white foil roll to edit. The user specifically dislikes the horizontal FOLD near the bottom and wants the entire broad printable sheet smooth. Remove the long transverse crease, hard highlight ridge, separate lower flap, seam line and ledge across the bottom of the white sheet. Make the broad sheet ONE continuous smooth unwrinkled white surface down to its bottom edge, with an extremely gentle seamless curvature only where it curls at the compact lower-left circular roll end. The small round roll/core at lower-left may remain, but its curl must flow tangentially into the sheet with NO crosswise fold or raised bar spanning the face. Maintain the accepted broad upright landscape silhouette, upper curved edge, clean right edge, same orthographic three-quarter viewpoint, center, size and 1536x1024 composition. One unprinted pure white material over all outer surfaces; only very subtle continuous light shading to convey volume, never a gray material band, chrome lower strip or dark crease. Soft upper-left light. Genuine transparent RGBA background. No white glow/halo outside the object, no floating flakes, no shadows outside object, no text/UI/card/floor/background. Clean antialiased contour. Change only this lower-surface geometry/smoothness; all other properties match the reference.
